title: A Inheritance for the Letter
author: Theo Dravenmoor
blurb: Gideon Voss, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
